title: AcademicComponentVersionContract
description: Contract schema for immutable component versions (Skill V1, Skill V2, Skill V3). Structurally guarantees immutable version lineage, cryptographic content verification, and authentic rollback capabilities.

version_id.description: Sequential immutable version identifier (e.g. V1, V2, V3).

parent_version.description: Direct parent version identifier, or null for initial baseline (V1).

component_id.description: Identifier of the versioned component (e.g. chapter-4-writing, academic-framework).

target_path.description: Path to the active production file on disk that this version materializes.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the immutable component content.

artifact_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the version artifact or bundle on disk.

evaluation_id.description: Evaluation report ID validating this version, or 'BASELINE' for initial version.

promotion_id.description: Promotion decision ID authorizing this version, or 'BASELINE' for initial version.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of version creation.
